title: Content Standard for an Accounting of Disclosures — Medical Records Request (Release of Information)
content:
What an accounting of disclosures produced by Riverbend Regional Health HIM under the Medical Records Request (Release of Information) product contains.

## Standard

An accounting lists the disclosures of the patient's information made in the look-back period — the product's number of look-back years before the request date — other than the kinds of disclosure excluded from an accounting, each with date, recipient, description and purpose.

## Each entry of an accounting

| Field of the entry | Content |
|---|---|
| Date | the date of the disclosure |
| Recipient | to whom the disclosure was made |
| Description | a description of what was disclosed |
| Purpose | the purpose of the disclosure |

## Inclusion test

A disclosure appears in the accounting when both hold:

1. it was made within the look-back years before the request date; and
2. it is not one of the excluded kinds (disclosures for treatment, payment and health care operations; disclosures to the patient; disclosures made under the patient's authorization; facility directory disclosures).

## Hypothetical disclosures tested, under the product's 6-year look-back

| Hypothetical disclosure | Made within 6 years before the request date? | Excluded kind? | Listed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| to a public health authority, 2 years before | yes | no | yes |
| to the patient's insurer for payment, 1 year before | yes | yes (payment) | no |
| to an attorney under the patient's authorization, 3 years before | yes | yes (authorized disclosure) | no |
| to a public health authority, 8 years before | no | no | no |

Delivery of the accounting fulfills the request.
